title: Apex Feeding Mode Overrun
dataSources: Apex controller readings (`apex:reading`), Seneye measurements (`seneye:reading`), reptile thermostat events (`reptilethermostat:event`), and misting-system cycles (`mister:cycle`).
app: Aquarium and terrarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, Seneye, reptile thermostats, and misting systems sent to Splunk HEC via controller APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=apex:reading
| search event="feed_mode" feed_mode_sec=*
| stats avg(feed_mode_sec) as avg_feed_mode_sec perc90(feed_mode_sec) as p90_feed_mode_sec count as samples by tank_name
| sort 0 - avg_feed_mode_sec
description: Measures Apex feeding-mode duration by tank.
value: Feed-mode overrun can leave pumps paused too long and quietly destabilize tank conditions.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for Apex feeding-mode duration to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 Apex feeding-mode duration.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how long Apex feeding-mode duration usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
